mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to lower cost of capital for corporate financing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate increase above 4.0% over 3 months signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.2pp increase) and decline in payrolls (PAYEMS > 10k decrease) over 3 months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% over 3 months signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0% in a high-unemployment regime.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 2000 thousand units (HOUST > 2000) reflects strong consumer demand for housing, which correlates with robust economic activity and positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through increased construction spending and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 115 over 3 months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 115 over a 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 350,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 350000) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through sustained earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 115) and acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% quarterly) over 3 months signals a supply shock that increases inflation and policy uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls < 115 and GDPC1 rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 115 and GDPC1 > 0.5% in 3 months.
